title: Chez Pierre Bakery Lakeview · Bakery · New Orleans
description: Lakeview's little French bakery with a Vietnamese kitchen in back. Breakfast, lunch, pastries, and cakes for every occasion on Harrison Avenue.
name: Chez Pierre Bakery Lakeview

hero.kicker: French bakery, cafe & Vietnamese kitchen · 141 Harrison Ave
hero.headline: Croissants at seven, banh mi at noon, a custom cake by Saturday.
hero.sub: Lakeview's little French bakery with a Vietnamese kitchen in back. Breakfast, lunch, pastries, and cakes for every occasion on Harrison Avenue.

paragraphs: Chez Pierre is the Lakeview bakery that does two things at once and does both properly. The front case is French: croissants, eclairs, fruit tarts, Eiffel Tower chocolates, king cake in season, and layer cakes decorated to order for birthdays, weddings, and Saints Sundays. The frozen matcha has a following.

The kitchen is Vietnamese, the way the best New Orleans bakeries often are. Banh mi on bread baked that morning, pho, summer rolls, crawfish pies, meat pies. Reviewers say people are sleeping on this place. Lindsay behind the counter would like that to stop.

facts: Vietnamese lunch: banh mi, pho, rolls

order.name: Breakfast Croissant
order.blurb: Sausage, egg, cheese on a house croissant. Reviewers use the word bomb.

order.name: Banh Mi
order.blurb: Grilled pork or chicken, pickled carrot, cilantro, pate, on bread from the oven behind you.

order.name: Custom Cakes
order.blurb: Birthdays, weddings, Mardi Gras. Order a week out, pick up on Harrison.

order.name: King Cake
order.blurb: Carnival season only. Traditional, filled, and the purple-green-gold done right.

items.name: Bánh Mì, grilled pork or chicken

menu.note: Case prices as tagged. Cakes quoted by size; call to order. Prices as posted and subject to change.

quote.text: “I get the feeling that folks are sleeping on this place too much. The banh mi is good and the folks working there are nice and attentive.”

reviews.text: “I get the feeling that folks are sleeping on this place too much. The bahn mi is good, and the folks working there are nice and attentive. It's a little dark inside, but otherwise the place is nicely decorated and welcoming.”

“Lindsay is always welcoming and makes the most scrumptious desserts!
I popped in for the frozen matcha and the shrimp Summer rolls. They didn’t disappoint and are always on point.”
“Breakfast croissant was the bomb. The women behind the counter were nice. Loved the interior design and vibe of the joint.”

tip.text: Order the cake by phone, then pick up a banh mi and a frozen matcha when you come to get it. Nobody leaves with just the cake.

getting_here: Harrison Ave between Canal Blvd and Argonne, Lakeview
5 minutes from City Park and the Lakefront
cta_h2: Come hungry. Chez Pierre Bakery Lakeview is waiting.
